email.body1:
Sara, saw Seerist's record commercial half and the AskAnna launch, plus the Janes partnership opening new defense and commercial demand.

When growth accelerates like that, the bottleneck usually moves to RevOps: more in-market accounts surface than reps can touch, and signal-to-action latency quietly caps coverage. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount, 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a pipeline gap analysis for Seerist tied to your hiring and tech-stack signals. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.subject2: 3 things in your outbound I'd change
email.body2:
Sara, quick follow-up for Seerist.

Most RevOps teams I see have clean data but slow routing: a signal fires, and it takes days to reach a rep with a personalized message. That latency is where 50-70% of response-rate lift hides, per our own best-practice data.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through a teardown of your current outbound, three changes I'd make, and how the signal-to-meeting handoff gets automated so nothing sits in a queue.
email.body3:
Sara, last bit of proof for Seerist.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Seerist's reply rate likely compares to peers scaling at your pace. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Sara, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If tightening signal-to-action latency isn't a RevOps priority this quarter, no problem at all. I know post-momentum quarters get loud fast, and not everything makes the roadmap.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your motion? I'll tailor it to Seerist either way.
